progression.prerequisiteKnowledge: C1 to C4B and Year 11: dynamic equilibrium means equal non-zero rates in a closed system; each rate depends on how often the reacting particles meet; a disturbance takes the mixture to a new settled mixture with different amounts; the C3 iron thiocyanate and cobalt tubes and the C4 hydrogen and iodine tube; pure solids do not count in a squeeze (C4A); concentration is amount per volume; coefficients count particles in a balanced equation; state symbols. Nothing about K, Q or ICE tables is assumed.
progression.startsWith: The iron thiocyanate tube settled at 10, 10, 10 and again at 15, 8, 12 after more iron is added, where every amount has changed but one ratio has not.
progression.stopsAfter: Stating that a fixed-temperature equilibrium has a constant concentration ratio and naming it K; writing the expression for a homogeneous solution reaction (and gas cases) from a balanced equation, with coefficients as powers and pure liquids and solids left out; reading a large, small or middling K for a stated reaction. No calculation of K from data, no ICE tables, no Q, no equation reversal or scaling, no temperature dependence, no Ka or Ksp.
progression.nextLesson: C6: when only the starting amounts are known, finding the settled mixture and K with an ICE table (the method is not named in this video).

teaching.task: Explain why the concentration ratio of a settled mixture stays constant, write the equilibrium expression for a balanced equation, and read the size of K.
teaching.causalExplanation: Each rate is a fixed number times the concentrations of the particles that must meet, and at equilibrium the two rates are equal, so dividing both sides leaves a ratio of fixed numbers that holds at one temperature. This ratio is K. When a species has a coefficient above one, that many particles must meet, so its concentration appears that many times over, which becomes a power. A pure solid or a solvent has a concentration that does not change, so it folds into the fixed numbers and is left out. K is products over reactants, so a large K means the settled mixture leans to products, and it says where the mixture settles, not how fast.
teaching.conversationalApproach: Opens on the iron tube where every amount changes but one ratio does not, derives the ratio from equal rates on two rate models, tests the product-with-powers form against two mixtures, then writes an expression from scratch for the cobalt tube, explains the left-out solid and solvent, reads K on a number line, and ends with an unseen copper ammonia and made-up A + B attempt.
teaching.openingDecision: When a settled mixture changes all its amounts, what stays the same, and how do you write it for any reaction?
teaching.understandingCheck: Write the equilibrium expression for Cu2+(aq) + 4NH3(aq) = [Cu(NH3)4]2+(aq) in dilute aqueous solution, and for A(aq) + B(aq) = C(aq) + D(aq) say what K = 4 tells you about a mixture that starts with equal A and B and no C or D.
teaching.curriculumScope: Deduce school concentration expressions for homogeneous solution reactions and read the magnitude of the equilibrium constant (Module 5). Calculating K from data, ICE tables, Q, reversing or scaling equations, temperature dependence of K, Ka and Ksp are deferred.

design.visualSystem: Explainer engine: warm paper stage, handwritten Caveat headings, amber doodle layer, the C3 iron and cobalt tubes and the C4 hot H2 + I2 tube (coded or painted) with C2 to C4B rate bars, a coded expression builder, a fraction bar with a same value tag, and a large versus small K number line. Colour key: Fe3+ pale yellow, SCN- grey, FeSCN2+ red, forward blue, reverse amber, equal teal.
design.transitionPlan: The iron tube shrinks to the corner for the rate bars; the same board carries the divide-both-sides step into the named K; the hot H2 + I2 tube replaces the iron tube for the power of two; the cobalt equation strip fills the board for the from-scratch stages; the beaker and carbon views replace it for the left-out scene; the number line draws on for the size of K; the attempt board removes the aids; the number line returns in the feedback; scene crossfade with settle.

scenes.visualReference: C3 iron thiocyanate tube (coded or painted) with three dot counts and a swatch strip, then two coded fractions and a dashed same value line
scenes.teachingReason: Poses the puzzle on a tube the learner already knows: every amount changes but one ratio does not
scenes.narrationCue: Here is the iron thiocyanate tube from earlier / Every amount has changed / Ten over ten times ten is a tenth / how do we write it for any reaction
scenes.motionPurpose: Seven pale yellow dots drop in and the counts slide from 10, 10, 10 to 15, 8, 12, then two fractions fill with the spoken numbers and a dashed line joins the two matching 0.1 values
scenes.onScreenChange: Heading writes on; the made-up numbers chip appears; seven iron dots drop in and the counts slide to 15, 8, 12 with a bracket "every amount has changed"; a fraction bar draws with the red ion on top; the first mixture drops in and "= 0.1" writes; the second drops in and "12 / 120 = 0.1" writes; a dashed "same value" line joins the two; a pen ring lands on the fraction on "this ratio"
scenes.holdPurpose: Brief hold on the two matching tenths

scenes.visualReference: C2 to C4B style rate bars (forward blue, reverse amber, teal equal bracket) with the iron tube shrunk to the corner
scenes.teachingReason: Gives the cause of the constant ratio: each rate is a fixed number times the concentrations that must meet, and the rates are equal
scenes.narrationCue: We write a species in square brackets for its amount per litre / joining runs at point three times the iron times the thiocyanate / splitting runs at three times the red ion / At equilibrium the rates are equal
scenes.motionPurpose: The tube shrinks away, a bracket pair writes round Fe3+, the forward line writes under the blue bar and the reverse line under the amber bar, and the two lines join with an equals sign
scenes.onScreenChange: The tube shrinks to the corner and two level rate bars sit under the teal bracket; a bracket pair writes round Fe3+ with the tag "amount per litre"; "forward = 0.3 x [Fe3+][SCN-]" writes under the blue bar with the three brackets ringed in turn; "reverse = 3 x [FeSCN2+]" writes under the amber bar; the lines join into "0.3 x [Fe3+][SCN-] = 3 x [FeSCN2+]"
scenes.holdPurpose: Hold the finished equal rates line for a beat

scenes.visualReference: The rate equation from the previous scene with pen cancelling and a fraction that writes step by step, then a large K
scenes.teachingReason: Shows the fixed numbers divide to a constant ratio and only then names it as the equilibrium constant
scenes.narrationCue: Divide both sides by three / equals point three over three, a tenth / Those two numbers are fixed / the equilibrium constant, K
scenes.motionPurpose: Pen divides both sides, the threes and the concentration brackets cancel and reappear on the other side, the fraction writes to 0.1, the two fixed numbers are circled and K writes large last
scenes.onScreenChange: "divide by 3" writes under the right side and the 3 cancels; "divide by [Fe3+][SCN-]" writes under the left and the brackets cancel and reappear under the red ion; the fraction "[FeSCN2+] / ([Fe3+][SCN-]) = 0.3 / 3 = 0.1" writes in steps; the 0.3 and 3 are circled with "fixed at one temperature"; K writes large on "name" with its plain meaning
scenes.holdPurpose: Hold the fraction and the named K into the next scene

scenes.visualReference: C4 hot H2 + I2 tube at 2, 2, 14 with two rate bars at 0.2 and the equation chip, plus a callback chip to the 2NO2 squeeze
scenes.teachingReason: Shows why a coefficient of two becomes a power of two: two HI must meet to split
scenes.narrationCue: joining needs a hydrogen and an iodine to meet / that number is point oh five / Splitting needs two hydrogen iodide to meet / hydrogen iodide squared / The coefficient two has become a power of two
scenes.motionPurpose: One H2 and one I2 drift together, 0.05 replaces the unknown number, two HI meet and split, their two brackets merge into a squared bracket, and the divide-both-sides move ends at 49
scenes.onScreenChange: One H2 and one I2 meet with a pen ring and "forward = number x [H2][I2]" writes, then "0.05 x 2 x 2 = 0.2"; two HI particles meet and split with the chip "like 2NO2 in the squeeze video" and "reverse = number x [HI] x [HI]" merges to "[HI]^2" with an arrow to the exponent; "0.2 / 14^2 = 0.05 / 49" writes; the rates are set equal and the ratio ends at 49 with the coefficient 2 flying to a power
scenes.holdPurpose: Hold the 49 and the power of two

scenes.visualReference: Coded expression builder (balanced equation strip, fraction, coefficients flying up as powers) and two H2 + I2 + HI tubes with dot counts
scenes.teachingReason: States the rule for any balanced equation and checks that the ratio stays put, but fails without the power
scenes.narrationCue: Products go on top, reactants underneath / raised to the power of its coefficient / fourteen squared over two times two / twenty-eight squared over two times eight / Leave the power off
scenes.motionPurpose: The general expression assembles term by term, then two tubes get their fractions in three beats each with a dashed same value line joining 49 and 49, and a second row without powers gives 3.5 and 1.75
scenes.onScreenChange: aA + bB = cC + dD writes and K assembles beneath it with each coefficient flying up as a power; the tag "checking that the ratio stays put" appears; two tubes (2, 2, 14 and 2, 8, 28) get "14^2 / (2 x 2) = 196 / 4 = 49" and "28^2 / (2 x 8) = 784 / 16 = 49" joined by a dashed same value line; a second row writes the no-power results 3.5 and 1.75 with a cross
scenes.holdPurpose: Hold the two 49s and the failed no-power row

scenes.visualReference: Equation strip for the cobalt tube with C3 pink and blue ion tints, state symbols, an empty fraction and the coefficient 4 flying to a power
scenes.teachingReason: Models writing an expression in three stages (states, products over reactants, powers) on an unseen equation
scenes.narrationCue: First, the states / so it stays out / Second, products over reactants / Third, each concentration to the power of its coefficient
scenes.motionPurpose: State symbols are ringed one by one, the water is struck out, the ions lift into a fraction and the 4 flies up to chloride as a power
scenes.onScreenChange: The equation strip writes on large; each state symbol is ringed, the three (aq) species get ticks and water gets a bar through it with "solvent: huge, steady amount"; an empty fraction draws and the blue ion lifts to the top, the pink ion and chloride to the bottom; the 4 flies to the top right of [Cl-] and the faint 1s fade; the finished expression writes and a pen ring marks the outer brackets

scenes.visualReference: Beaker with many water dots and a few reacting dots, two counters, a coded carbon block with a CO2 and CO particle view, and the C4A carbon equation
scenes.teachingReason: Gives the reason a solid or the solvent drops out: its concentration does not change, so it folds into a fixed number
scenes.narrationCue: their concentration does not change / just another fixed number / the carbon never appears / its concentration changes, so it counts
scenes.motionPurpose: A water counter stays level while a dissolved counter ticks, the locked counter slides into the fixed number, the carbon is greyed out of the expression, and a steam icon gets a tick
scenes.onScreenChange: The water counter stays level while a dissolved-species counter ticks up and down; the locked counter slides into the circled fixed number with "fixed x fixed = fixed"; a carbon block appears with its level counter and "pure solid" tag; C(s) + CO2(g) = 2CO(g) writes, the (s) is crossed and "K = [CO]^2 / [CO2]" builds; a steam icon lands with "(g): concentration changes" and a tick

scenes.visualReference: Coded horizontal log number line from 10^-30 to 10^13 with three rough guide bands and markers with H2 + I2, N2 + O2 and copper ammonia icons
scenes.teachingReason: Teaches reading the size of K as a rough guide and that K says where the mixture settles, not how fast
scenes.narrationCue: the bigger it is / a K above about a thousand / a K of forty-nine / ten to the minus thirty / ten to the thirteen / not how fast it gets there
scenes.motionPurpose: The number line writes on, a pen arrow runs right on "bigger", the band edges ring in turn and three markers drop one at a time with their icons and tags
scenes.onScreenChange: The log line writes on with the bands "below about 10^-3: mostly reactants", "10^-3 to 10^3: both present in measurable amounts" and "above about 10^3: mostly products" and the tag "rough guides, around 0.1 to 1 mol/L"; a pen arrow runs right; the two band edges ring in turn; markers drop at 49 (H2 + I2 tube, "lots of HI, some H2 and I2 left"), at 10^-30 (N2 and O2 flask, "very little NO") and at 10^13 (copper ammonia, "almost all the copper is in the ion"); a tag "where it settles, not how fast" lands last

scenes.visualReference: Large handwritten aid in three lines, each lifting to a small icon (fraction bar, power arrow, greyed solid and droplet), with the condition tag
scenes.teachingReason: Gives a reusable writing shortcut after the cause is explained
scenes.narrationCue: Here is a shortcut for writing any expression / Products over reactants, coefficients become powers / the solvent drop out
scenes.motionPurpose: The aid writes on in three short lines, each lifting to its icon, and the solid and droplet grey out on the last line
scenes.onScreenChange: The three aid lines write on large; a fraction bar, a coefficient flying to a power, and a greyed solid and droplet ("or the solvent") appear in turn; the condition tag "written for the equation as given, concentrations in mol/L, water as solvent or gas" lands and the board holds
scenes.holdPurpose: Hold the aid for about 3 seconds after the last word

scenes.visualReference: Coded vignette: a pale blue copper tube with the Cu2+ and NH3 equation strip, and a made-up A + B flask with its strip, plus two numbered demands
scenes.teachingReason: Unseen transfer on the power of four and the product over reactant form, and on reading K = 4, with every condition visible and no answer cues
scenes.narrationCue: Your turn / copper two plus ions and ammonia make a deep blue ion / where A and B make C and D / In this question K is four / Pause here to answer
scenes.motionPurpose: The countdown ring runs through the answer-free thinking hold
scenes.onScreenChange: The copper tube with its equation and condition tag and the made-up flask with "start with equal A and B and no C or D" appear as each is named; the two numbered demands stay on screen; earlier boards and the aid are removed; the countdown ring starts after the narration
scenes.holdPurpose: Quiet answer-free thinking hold with a 10 second countdown

scenes.visualReference: The copper equation strip with the expression builder, a numerator lift, a coefficient flying up as a power and two crossed wrong-answer chips
scenes.teachingReason: Explains item one stage by stage and corrects the multiplier and the addition slips
scenes.narrationCue: Products on top, reactants underneath / to the power of four / a coefficient is a power, not a multiplier / so the counts multiply
scenes.motionPurpose: The copper strip writes on and the expression builds, the new ion lifts up, the 4 flies to ammonia as a power and two wrong chips are crossed on their cues
scenes.onScreenChange: The equation strip writes on; the new ion lifts to the numerator, Cu2+ and NH3 to the denominator, and the 4 flies up as a power; "K = [[Cu(NH3)4]2+] / ([Cu2+][NH3]^4)" holds; the chip "4[NH3] in the denominator" is crossed with "a coefficient is a power"; the chip "[Cu2+] + [NH3]^4 underneath" is crossed with "counts multiply: particles must meet" and a callback tag to the iron tube

scenes.visualReference: The A + B strip with the expression builder, the K number line with a marker at 4 and a bar showing one third left and two thirds converted
scenes.teachingReason: Explains item two and shows that K = 4 means measurable amounts of all four, not mostly products
scenes.narrationCue: The products go on top, C times D / Underneath go the reactants, A times B / about two thirds of the A reacting / not almost all products
scenes.motionPurpose: The expression builds with no powers, a marker drops at 4 inside the middle band, a short working line writes and a bar splits into one third A and two thirds products
scenes.onScreenChange: The strip writes on and "K = [C][D] / ([A][B])" builds; the number line returns with a marker at 4 in the middle band, a tick on "both present" and a cross on "mostly products"; the working line "x / (a - x) = 2, so x = two thirds of a" writes; a bar shows one third of A left and two thirds turned into C and D; a short unspoken note about the solvent sits under the expression
scenes.holdPurpose: Hold the bar and the corrected reading

scenes.visualReference: Two question cards with fraction, power arrow and state-symbol icons and a miniature K number line, then a tube with starting counts and a question mark
scenes.teachingReason: Packs the lesson into two reusable questions and hands off to finding the settled mixture
scenes.narrationCue: write products over reactants / leave out pure solids, a pure liquid and the solvent / When it gives you K, read its size first / when you only know the starting amounts
scenes.motionPurpose: Two cards write on one by one, then a tube with starting counts appears with a question mark over the settled counts and a next chip
scenes.onScreenChange: The first card "Given an equation: fraction, powers, check the states." writes on with its icons; the second card "Given K: above about 1000, below about 1/1000, or between?" writes on with the mini number line; on "starting amounts" a tube with starting counts and a "?" over the settled counts appears with a Next chip
scenes.holdPurpose: Hold about 3 seconds after the last word

scenes.visualReference: Key notes card with the memory aid in large writing and its condition tag
scenes.motionPurpose: Notes appear then stay still for copying
scenes.onScreenChange: The notes and the memory aid appear and lock
scenes.holdPurpose: Quiet copy hold of about 60 seconds with pause invitation
